description: List the actions of the Galon API, for every solution, with their risk and permission. Use when no other tool does what the person asks. Before: nothing; filter with service or query. Returns actions: id, description, solution, method, path, permission, allowed and missing_permission (for this key or connection), risk (read, write, spend, destructive, public, production), approval (required or none for this connection), cost and params; with action: its body schema; then galon_call. Cost: free.

action.description: One action id: that action in full, with the JSON schema of its body and parameters.

query.description: Words to find in the action id, description or path.

service.description: Only the actions of this solution.

name: galon_actions
title: List Galon API actions
